verdict: key consistent: 92 signs = 92 letters of the cipher's text, 26 groups = 26 words, one letter per shape at skeleton level (S9 = ف four times and the ق of القلب); homophones ن (S4, S13), ح (S10, S14, S19). The 7v l.12-13 rows belong to the chain; the cipher's mawwal differs from the record in nine places
notes: Rows 7v l.12-13 (image 0084_0019) and 8r l.1-5 (image 0084_0020). Signs per row 15,12,14,15,14,15,7 = 92 (record 16,14,14,16,16,16,10 = 102); dividers 3,4,3,5,4,4,3 = 26 (record 19). Cipher's text: يا من وصالو لاطفال الحمبة نح لم تتلف الصب بالهجران اوا اح رميت ف ي القلب واوا والتصبر بح كل الوري دح في عيني وشحصد ذح. Against the record: (1) group 4 has 6 signs, لاطفال (the page also seems to write لاطفا ل before المحبة); (2) group 5 is ا ل S10 S3 ب ة: S3 = م in من, لم, رميت, so the encipherer wrote الحمبة with ح and م transposed (keyed as written); (3) لم, not كم (S7 = ل throughout; the page has كم: a variant or slip); (4) after بالهجران the cipher has اوا | اح, the words the record calls interlinear variants ('او اح', written above كح on 8r l.8), then رميت (S17 = ر in بالهجران, والتصبر, الوري), where the record has يميت; (5) في (before القلب) is split by a divider into ف | ي; (6) والتصبر بح, not نح (S11 = ب in الصب, بالهجران, القلب); (7) كحل is 2 signs د ح (S23 = د as in the last letter of وشحصد; the page has كح, not كحل); (8) عيني, not عين (4 signs ع ي ن ي; the page has عيني); (9) وشحصد, not وشهد (5 signs و ش ح ص د; the page has وشحصد). With these the totals match exactly; the record's excess (+17) came from segmenter overcounts and the reading. The rhyme words نح / بح / دح / ذح fit the mawwal's -aḥḥ refrain.
